notes.title: Update notes for September 15th, 2024
notes.notes:
First update here we go!! ːsteamhappyː
Game jumps from v1.20 to v1.24 today.

[h2]Bug squashing[/h2]
[list]
[*]Issue: With damaged (1 to 3) systems, repairing on habitable planets, hovering over the "repair" button, the game would freeze.
Cause : Infinite loop executing on the damaged systems blue notification effect.
Solution : Loop closed, no execution till infinity ^^'.
[*]Issue : With arsenal lvl3, it's possible to pay ransom without money.
Cause : Code error in resource verification for action.
Solution : Condition correction for action validation.
[*]Spying 1 to 3 jumps away, arriving with 0 invisibility, spying doesn't consume the other actions possible on that spot, which the player can still perform if the conditions are met.
[*]Sound FX made to overlap instead of the new one playing cutting the previous.
[*]Master warning/master caution blinking again with the new random failure system (see below)
[*]Map reticle made to disappear with the entity that the player engaged with (see new topography reticle below)
[*]Autonomy overshooting corrected (capped at 32 jumps)
[/list]

[h2]New content[/h2]
[list]
[*]Sound FX : +1 reputation
[*]Sound FX : entering pokemon mode
[*]Sound FX : combat ambiance sound
[*]Sound FX : enemy lvl1 movement on map
[*]Sound FX : enemy lvl2 movement on map
[*]Sound FX : enemy lvl3 movement on map
[*]Sound FX : asteroid collision damage on map
[*]Sound FX : sun damage on map
[*]Sound FX : gaz planet pressure damage on map
[*]Sound FX : module destroyed
[*]Sound FX : click on topography
[*]Sound FX : added disctinct neutral attacks sounds for all neutral levels
[*]Sound FX : modified warning sounds when engaging with an enemy, all levels
[*]Sound FX : added spying sound
[*].exe game logo replacing the Unity logo
[*]Zoom on topography cursor hover
[*]Entity selection reticle on topography
[*]Added spying visual clues
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*]Destroying neutrals reduces reputation in accordance with their level (-1,-2,-3)
[*][b]FAILURES ARE NOW RANDOM[/b] yay ! Repairing still occurs with priority of module (from bottom to top of the list) and module state (red, then orange)
[*]Score is now: "turns/reputation", which is much more legible
[*]"Surrender" goes from +1 reputation to +2.
[/list]

[h2]Ergonomy[/h2]
[list]
[*]Sound after resource acquirement doesn't play anymore when that resource is maxed out
[*]Sound delay tweaked for warning sounds
[*]Music sound controller added on top of ambient, effects and principal
[*]Game over music sound now only plays once
[*]English translation fix : repair hull -> Hull (action réparation)
[*]English translation fix : ship : -> hull : (fiche codex vaisseau allié)
[*]Red notification added on money when repairing is not possible due to lack of money
[/list]

[h2]Technicals[/h2]
[list]
[*]Project updated for Unity 6 (6000.0.18f1).
[/list]
